translation: And the Chong and Ren vessels follow the abdomen and flanks, flanking the side of the navel, flowing to Qichong, belonging to the Belt Vessel, and connecting to the Governing Vessel. The Chong, Ren, and Governing vessels arise together but travel differently; one source with three branches, all connecting to the Belt Vessel. Because the various channels come and go above and below, they leave residual heat among the Belt Vessel; guest heat becomes depressed and suppressed, and white matter overflows, descending with urination (sou), continuous and unending; this is white vaginal discharge. The Inner Classic says: When thoughts are boundless and one's desires are not obtained, and the mind is given over to external things, and intercourse is too excessive, it develops into sinew flaccidity (jinwei) and also into white emission (baiyin).
